posts.text:
Last time the Fed hiked before an election? 2022 midterm under Biden. 

From 1984 to 2024, the Fed adjusted rates (up or down) within 60 days of an election (43%) as often as in any other 60-day period (45%).
posts.summary: Fed rate decisions not systematically timed to elections
